variants.name: Can the Eel Come Out to Play?
Red Coins on the Ship Afloat

onClick.title: Signpost
onClick.body:
ATTENTION! 
Read Before Diving In!
You'll run out of air
if you linger underwater.


Return to the surface, 
find an air bubble, or
collect coins to 
breathe while underwater.


In Standard Mode, press 
 to swim and 
hold it down to swim 
at a slow and steady 
pace. Tap  
rhythmically to speed up.
Hold down  to swim 
quickly. Press Up on the
 and press  to 
dive. Press Down on the
 and  to return 
to the surface.
You'll jump out of the 
water when you're at 
the surface. To turn
around quickly, stop and
press the  in the
direction you want to go.

onClick.title: Signpost
onClick.body:
When you step on the 
strange ? Switch
hidden in the castle, 
the ? Blocks will 
become solid. 

Some of these blocks 
have useful items inside.
Get the items by 
breaking the blocks. 
But beware! Some 
blocks are duds.

onClick.title: Signpost
onClick.body:
Keep out! 
That means you!
Arrgghh!


Anyone entering this 
cave without permission
will meet certain 
disaster.
    --The Cap'n

onClick.title: Signpost
onClick.body:
Aarrgh! Ahoy, matey. I
have sunken treasure
here, I do.


But to pluck the 
plunder, you must open
the treasure chests in
the right order.

What order is that, 
ye say?
I'll never tell!

    --The Cap'n

onClick.title: Signpost
onClick.body:
Climbing's easy! When you
jump at trees, poles, or
pillars, you'll grab them
automatically. 
In Standard Mode:
Press the  Up or 
Down to climb.
Crouch to stop climbing.


To rotate around the 
object, press Right or 
Left on the .


Leap toward the
character's back to jump
off in that direction.


When you reach the top,
press Up on the  to
do a handstand! Jump off
from the handstand for a
high, stylin' dismount.

onClick.title: Signpost
onClick.body:
Certain people have a 
natural agility and 
lightness. These 
slender wisps can run 
on water for a bit...
But only if they 
sprint towards it!
I wonder why they have
that power...

Maybe it's those 
green caps they wear 
that make them as 
light and flexible as 
blades of grass.
They are delicate and 
sensitive creatures, so
be nice when you see 
them.

onClick.title: Signpost
onClick.body:
When using the Touch
Screen, it's easy to walk
or run.
You can even calmly and
coolly navigate your way
across narrow ledges.
Use the thumb pad on the
wrist strap for smoother 
control than your finger.

onClick.title: Signpost
onClick.body:
In front of you is a 
Star Switch. Step on it
to make a Star appear
in the course. Hurry to
collect the Star before
it disappears!
Don't forget that you 
can check the Star's
location on the Touch 
Screen map.
